coordinate_system.origin: midpoint between pupils, at the corneal plane

sensors.name: cam_L
sensors.note: DVP/SCCB. Working distance set by vertex distance + bridge offset.

sensors.name: irled_L
sensors.note: 940 nm. Invisible to the eye so it does not itself drive the reflex. Irradiance at the corneal plane must be checked against IEC 62471.

sensors.name: thermo_L
sensors.note: I2C, address collision -> TCA9548A. 90 deg FOV means the spot grows fast with standoff; this drives the standoff constraint.

sensors.name: ppg_L
sensors.note: 660 nm + 880 nm. Faces medially into the skin. The LED-photodiode separation inside this package is what the Monte Carlo model sizes.

sensors.name: elec_L_brow_med
sensors.note: Dry Ag/AgCl-coated silicone contact, 6 mm. Local tetrapolar set per eye (drive brow_lat->nose_inf, sense brow_med->nose_sup).

sensors.name: elec_L_brow_lat
sensors.note: Dry Ag/AgCl-coated silicone contact, 6 mm. Local tetrapolar set per eye (drive brow_lat->nose_inf, sense brow_med->nose_sup).
